name: Faun
body:
Often mistaken for satyrs, fauns are a much rarer but more genteel type of fey who enjoy interacting with others, and can often be found in the company of nymphs, dryads, elves, and centaurs.

Physical

Fauns have the upper torso of a human-like humanoid, but the legs, tail, and horns of a goat. They can usually be distinguished from their more mischievous satyr cousins by their more human visage and taller, more upright posture—although the two species are sometimes difficult to truly tell apart.

Fauns are evenly split between male and female, as opposed to satyrs who are almost without exception male.

Social

Like satyrs, fauns enjoy the simple pleasures of life, including wine, music, and dancing.

However, where satyrs are unpredictable and hedonistic, fauns tend to be good-natured and social creatures who enjoy social settings and the company of others.

While they usually dwell in wild places, they are not afraid to travel and visit with humanoids in their towns and villages.

Alignment and Religion

Like satyrs, fauns have a strong tendency toward Chaotic alignments, with personal freedom and autonomy being strong values.

Satyrs feel a strong urge to embody the chaotic side of nature, becoming a living embodiment of the wild places they serve and protect. Fauns are not just creatures of nature, however—they are legitimately invested in the lives of those around them and seek to minimize their suffering. Thus they lean not just toward Chaos, but also toward Good.

As fey, most fauns have a hands-off view of religion, believing that their afterlife is already guaranteed through reincarnation in the Fey Realms. However, some do venerate various fey lords, or practice some kind of nature worship or philosophy.

Base Traits
Ability Score Modifiers You are quick and assertive, but often frivolous. Your ability score adjustments are +2 Dex, +2 Cha, –2 Wis [standard].
Size As a Medium creature, you have no bonuses or penalties due to size.
Type You are a Fey.
Speed Normal. Your base speed is 30 feet.
Languages You begin play speaking Common and Sylvan. If you have a high Intelligence score, you can choose from any of the following languages: Elven, Giant, Gnome, Goblin, and Halfling.
Alternate Traits
Fey Defenses You gain DR 2/cold iron and a +1 natural armor bonus to Armor Class.
Horns You have a pair of horns that you can use to make a ramming or gore attack. Choose either bludgeoning or piercing damage; once you’ve made this decision, it can’t be changed. Your horns are a primary natural attack that deals 1d4 damage of the type chosen. If you make this attack at the end of a charge, your horns instead deal 2d4 damage plus 1-1/2 times your Strength bonus.
Jumper You are always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump.
Low-Light Vision You can see twice as far as a human in starlight, moonlight, torchlight, and similar conditions of poor illumination. You retain the ability to distinguish color and detail under these conditions.
Reveler Diplomacy and Perform are always class skills for you.
Spell-Like Abilities 1/day—ghost sound, hideous laughter, and sleep. Your character level is your caster level, and Charisma is your casting ability.
Alternate Species Traits
Change Shape You can assume the appearance of a single human, half-elf, or elf. (Once chosen, this selection cannot be changed.) This form is static and cannot be changed each time you take this form. You gain a +10 species bonus on Disguise checks made to appear as the member of the species whose appearance you assume, and you do not take a penalty for being a creature of a different type. Changing your shape is a ? standard action. This trait otherwise functions as alter self, save that you do not adjust your ability scores. This trait replaces spell-like abilities.
Explorer Linguistics and Survival are always class skills for you. This trait replaces reveler.
Fey Damage Resistance Your resistance to damage is greater than most fauns. You gain DR 5/cold iron. This trait replaces fey defenses.
Fey Spell Resistance You are infused with the magic of the Fey Realms. You gain spell resistance equal to 11 + your character level. This trait replaces fey defenses.
Runner Some fauns have the lower bodies that resemble horses more than goats. You gain Run as a bonus feat. This trait replaces jumper.
Seducer You add +1 to the saving throw DCs for your spells and spell-like abilities of the enchantment school. In addition, if you have a Charisma score of 11 or higher, you may use charm person once per day as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to your character level). This trait replaces spell-like abilities.
Favored Class Bonuses
Bard Add one spell known from the bard spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level bard spell you can cast.
Druid Add +1/2 to wild empathy checks.
Mesmerist When casting mesmerist enchantment spells, add +1/2 to the effective caster level of the spell, but only to determine the spell’s duration.
Oracle Add one spell known from the oracle spell list. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level oracle spell you can cast.
Ranger Add DR 1/cold iron to your animal companion. Each additional time you select this benefit, the DR/cold iron increases by +1/2 (maximum DR 10/cold iron). If you ever replace your animal companion, the new companion gains this DR.
Rogue Add a +1/2 bonus to Bluff checks to pass secret messages or create a distraction to hide, and a +1/2 bonus to Acrobatics checks to jump.
Skald Increase your total number of raging song rounds per day by +1.
Sorcerer Add +1/4 to the DC of enchantment spells.
Swashbuckler Increase the number of times per day you can use charmed life by +1/4.
Witch Add +1 spell from the witch spell list to your familiar. This spell must be at least one spell level below the highest-level witch spell you can cast. If you ever replace your familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
